FRONT.label: front view
FRONT.orientation_sentence: The head, torso, and feet all point directly toward the viewer.

FRONT.instruction: Render the character from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.

body_instructions.body-reference: Render the body from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.
body_instructions.head-fitment: Use the Reference Body as a direct front-view neck-fitment source. The body faces the viewer squarely.

head_instructions.head-fitment: Render the Character Head and fitted neck from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.

FRONT_LEFT_3_4.label: front-left three-quarter view

FRONT_LEFT_3_4.camera_position: The camera is positioned in front of and to the character's anatomical left.
FRONT_LEFT_3_4.costume_dressing_orientation_lock: Preserve the exact supplied front-left three-quarter angle. Do not repaint the face into a direct front view or create independent eye contact.
FRONT_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a front-left three-quarter body view. Treat this as one physical camera angle, not a direct front view and not a profile view. The torso, shoulders, neck, mannequin head, face plane, eye gaze, hips, knees, and feet all share the same front-left three-quarter direction. Do not turn the head or eyes toward the viewer independently. Do not reverse the requested anatomical left-right orientation, and do not introduce twisting between the head, torso, hips, or feet.

Render the body from a front-left three-quarter body view. Treat this as one physical camera angle, not a direct front view and not a profile view. body_instructions.head-fitment: Use the Reference Body as a front-left three-quarter neck-fitment source. The Reference Body controls camera angle, torso direction, shoulder direction, neck base position, mannequin head orientation, face direction, and neck docking angle. Fit the head-and-neck module to that same front-left three-quarter orientation; do not create a viewer-facing head, profile head, twisted neck, or independently turned gaze.
body_instructions.character-assembly: Preserve the Reference Body as a front-left three-quarter full-body source. The Reference Body controls camera angle, full-body framing, torso direction, shoulder direction, neck base position, mannequin head orientation, face direction, hip direction, knee direction, and foot direction. Fit the Character Head onto that same front-left three-quarter orientation; do not rotate, mirror, reinterpret, or turn the head toward the viewer independently.
body_instructions.costume-dressing: Preserve the Assembled Character source as a front-left three-quarter full-body source. Treat the head, neck, shoulders, torso, hips, knees, and feet as one locked front-left three-quarter orientation. Do not rotate, mirror, repaint a viewer-facing head, create a profile body, or reinterpret the body direction while replacing the costume.

head_instructions.head-fitment: Render the Character Head and fitted neck from a front-left three-quarter view. The face plane, nose direction, eye gaze, ears, jaw, skull, and neck axis all share that same front-left three-quarter orientation. Do not turn the eyes toward the viewer, twist the neck, mirror the head, or drift into a direct front or profile view.
head_instructions.character-assembly: Use the Character Head for identity only, then align it to the Reference Body's front-left three-quarter head orientation. The final face plane, nose direction, eye gaze, ears, jaw, skull, and neck axis must share the Reference Body direction. Do not preserve a source head pose that conflicts with the Reference Body.
